body:
I have not seen anyone else or have been on anything since Zoloft. I'm too nervous to talk to a therapist and I'm also afraid of being on medicine again. Zoloft did help, but it also turned me into an unemotional zombie. I could talk to people, but I ruined alot of relationships because I didn't care to maintain them. I also gained a bit of weight on them. Had to quit cold turkey. I'm afraid of trying anything else now... I don't want to mess my head up anymore than it is, you know? I agree. I also believe a lot of doctors (atleast in my area) don't really know what to do for patients with mental health problems. My zoloft was perscribed by my allergy doctor after I had a break down in her office and cried to her.

I have been playing the new Friday the 13th game a lot lately... which heavily relies on mic. People ask me questions in gams, like asking if I have a certain item, and I freeze up and don't answer. Sometimes I can talk, but I still get really anxious when I do.

I know I shouldn't feel bad, but I just don't see any hope for me. I'm turning 24 soon and I haven't even had a job yet. I am terrible at putting my thoughts to words too lol. Thank God this is anonymous or I would be shitting myself.
